5. The facts of the case are that on 31.05.1997 at about 2 pm C.R. Sharma the Food Inspector suspecting besan to be adulterated took its sample from the shop of the revisionist where it was kept for sale and sent it for analysis to the public analyst.
The same was analysed in which the public analyst through its report dated 30.06.1997 reported it to be containing Khesari Dal which was prohibited item.
Proceedings were then undertaken and sanction of the C.M.O., Allhabad was taken after which notice under Section 13 (2) of the Act of 1954 was sent to the revisionist on 21.04.1999.
6. A complaint dated 20.04.1999 was filed before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Allahabad on 10.05.1999.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The trial in the mater started in which C.R. Sharma examined as P.W.-1 and Sanjay Kumar Srivastava the Food Clerk was examined as P.W.-2.
7.
The accused in his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. denied the prosecution version and stated that no such sample was taken from his shop.

8. The trial court after considering the evidence came to a conclusion that the prosecution has proved its case beyond reasonable doubt and convicted & sentenced the revisionist vide the judgement & order dated 28.05.2010 for offences under Section 2(1A) (M) (44) (B) 7(1)/16(1-A) (11)
Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for six months rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.
1000/- and in default of payment of fine, the revisionist has to undergo further detention for a period of one month simple imprisonment.
9.

An appeal being Criminal Appeal No. 146 of 2010 (Ashok Kumar Vs. State of U.P. and others) was preferred before the Appellate Court which stood dismissed vide the judgement and order dated 05.07.2011 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 15, Allahabad and the judgement &
order dated 28.05.2010 of the trial court was affirmed.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 15, Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The present revision has thus been filed before this Court.

10. Learned counsel for the revisionist has agitated single argument that the valuable right of the revisionist under Section 13 (2) of the Act has been defeated in as much as notice under Section 13 (2) of the Act has been sent to the revisionist on 21.04.1999 which is about 19 days prior to the filing of the present complaint which has been filed on 10.05.1999.

It is submitted that as such the revisionist was not in the knowledge of the fact as to where he has to exercise his right or not and thus the said right gets defeated since the notice has been sent prior to the filing of the complaint.
Learned counsel has relied upon the judgement of this Court in the case of Muzaffar Vs. State of U.P.:1987 ACC 25 to buttress the said argument.

entities.text: Muzaffar Vs. State of U.P.:1987 ACC 25
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is submitted that since the right under Section 13 (2) of the Food Adulteration Act has been defeated, the present revision deserves to be allowed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State although opposed the revision and argument but could not dispute the factual aspect of the matter.

12. After having heard the learned counsels for the parties, perusing the records and also the trial court records and the judgement as relied upon by learned counsel for the revisionist, it transpires that notice under Section 13 (2) of the Act has been sent prior to the filing of the complaint to the revisionist.
The provision as contained in Section 13 (2) of the Act is a mandatory provision and has to be complied with.
A failure on any count or irregularity in the same would prejudice the accused in his defence.
In the present case the report has been sent 19 days prior to the filing of the complaint.
The revisionist thus gets prejudiced because of the same in his defence.
13. The present revision is allowed.

The impugned judgement and order dated 05.07.2011 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 15, Allahabad and the impugned order dated 28.05.2010 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Allahabad are hereby set aside.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 15, Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 14. The revisionist-Ashok Kumar is acquitted of the charge levelled against him.
The revisionist is on bail.
His bail bond is cancelled and sureties discharged.
15. Office is directed to transmit the copy of this judgement along with the trial court records to the concerned trial court forthwith for its compliance and necessary action.
16. The file be consigned to records.
